title: feat(sdui-parser)!: one parser body in @objectstack/sdui-parser (#25712 2g PR 1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_

Part of #25712 (4b 2g PR 1: one parser body; Tier S).
Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing: `validateTree` now also judges the nodes held in a manifest entry's declared `slots`, so a caller whose manifest carries `slots` gets diagnostics on slot-held nodes it did not get before)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:**
  - 按 2g 裁定(#25712 记录 6418729849,E+B),把渲染器那份 `@object-ui/sdui-parser` 多出来的东西并进 `@objectstack/sdui-parser`,包括节点槽位校验、已退役的 `body` 写法、html 层来源标记,以及它多导出的符号。
  - `body-dialect.ts` 和 `provenance.ts` 从 MIT 包整体搬入,保留 MIT 声明,并随包发布 `LICENSE-MIT`。
  - 两份不一致的地方按本包规则:非 enum 的 `type-mismatch` / `member-type-mismatch` 仍然一律是 error;`unconsumed-widget-option` 仍写成字面量。
  - `SchemaNode` / `ValidationResult` 改名为 `ParsedSchemaNode` / `ManifestValidationResult`,旧名保留为 `@deprecated` 别名,不删任何导出。
- **哪些原来能保存的现在会被拒:没有。** 保存门(`os validate` / `build` / `lint` 和 `os serve` 的保存入口)读的是仓里跟踪的 `sdui.manifest.json`,也就是 `@objectstack/console` 随包带的那份。它 106 个条目里 0 个带 `slots`,所以新增的槽位遍历在保存门上无事可做。只有自己用 `slotsFor` 生成清单的调用方才会走到它,今天只有渲染器,而渲染器那份解析器本来就在遍历。
- **为什么改:** 两份解析器靠 `check:sdui-lockstep` 维持同一套语法和诊断码,其余部分各自漂移。本 PR 是 2g 的第 1 步。PR 2 把 ui 的 122 个引用改到本包并删除 ui 那份;PR 3 退役 lockstep 门。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 库层面的收窄,带 BREAKING 标注,按 `patch` 发布(元数据协议不变)。`parseJsx` 产出的节点多了一个 JSON 看不见的 symbol 标记。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **你要做的:** 无(Tier S)。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

Two copies of the constrained JSX parser existed:
- `@objectstack/sdui-parser` (`packages/sdui-parser`), which the save gate runs;
- `@object-ui/sdui-parser` (`ui/packages/sdui-parser`), which the renderer runs.

`check:sdui-lockstep` held them to one grammar region, one diagnostic-code set and one containment predicate, and they drifted everywhere else. Tesla's 2g ruling keeps `@objectstack/sdui-parser` as the one package with no forwarding release, deletes the old package, rewrites its importers and takes `@object-ui/sdui-parser` out of the fixed group. This PR is step 1: the body becomes one, here. The plan, module by module, is #25712 comment 6419004222.

## What changes

### Source, module by module

| Module | Winner | What this PR does |
|---|---|---|
| `input-type.ts` | n/a | Unchanged; the copies were identical. |
| `codegen.ts` | ui | The generated `.d.ts` header gains `/* eslint-disable */` and names `@objectstack/sdui-parser`. No checked-in output carries the header. |
| `parse.ts` | ui | `ParsedSchemaNode`. Every element is stamped with `markHtmlTierNode` at production. The LOCKSTEP comments go; the `forbidden-attr` rationale no longer leans on the gate. |
| `types.ts` | ui | Adds `ParsedSchemaNode`, `ManifestValidationResult` and `ManifestComponent.slots`. Keeps `SchemaNode` and `ValidationResult` as `@deprecated` aliases. |
| `index.ts` | ui | The renderer copy's superset of exports (below) and `manifestFromConfigs`' `slotsFor` option. The `binding` note keeps this copy's pointer to the single record in `types.ts`. |
| `validate.ts` | ui code, **os severity** | Adds the node-slot walk (objectui#11170) and the `body` replacement in the unknown-prop branch. `checkType` and `checkMemberTypes` keep this package's rule: every mismatch is an `error`. The LOCKSTEP comments go. |
| `dashboard-widget-options.ts` | os code, ui header | The emitted `code:` stays an inline literal, because of `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`. The header takes the renderer's census derivation, re-rooted to the `ui/` paths now in this tree, and keeps the spec-side drift section that `check:widget-option-census` holds. |
| `body-dialect.ts` | moved in | MIT notice kept. |
| `provenance.ts` | moved in | MIT notice kept. The registry key `@object-ui/sdui-parser.html-tier-node` is unchanged, because it is the cross-instance contract. |

**New exports:**
- `HTML_TIER_NODE`, `isHtmlTierNode`, `markHtmlTierNode`;
- `acceptsChildren`, `CHILD_LIST_KEY`, `SDUI_BASE_PROPS`, `SduiBaseProp`, `SduiBasePropScope`;
- `checkRetiredBodyDialect`, `RETIRED_CHILD_LIST_KEY`;
- `NodeSlotDeclarationLike`, `assertFullyLoaded`, `RegistryConfigLike.lazy`.

These cover every name the 2g-b importer inventory needs.

### Licence

- `packages/sdui-parser/LICENSE-MIT` is a verbatim copy of `ui/packages/sdui-parser/LICENSE` (MIT, Copyright (c) 2024 ObjectQL), added to `files`. `npm pack --dry-run` lists it. `scripts/check-published-files.mjs` registers it in `EXTRA_ENTRIES` with its reason, because the gate admits no unexplained `files` entry.
- The two moved modules open with a `/*! … */` notice that names the licence, the copyright line and `LICENSE-MIT`. esbuild keeps it in both `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`.
- The four ported tests that carried the renderer's MIT header keep it, with its pointer retargeted to `LICENSE-MIT`.
- The `license` field stays `Apache-2.0`.

### Behaviour, measured

- **The save gate's verdicts do not move.** `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` generates the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` through `manifestFromConfigs` without `slotsFor`, so 0 of its 106 entries carry `slots`. `packages/console/build-dist.sh` copies that file over the console's `dist/sdui.manifest.json`, and that copy is what `resolveSduiManifest` gives `os validate`, `build`, `lint` and `os serve`'s save door. The slot walk only works for a caller that builds a manifest with `slotsFor`. Today that is the renderer, whose own copy already walks the slots.
- **`body`.** The message now names `children`. A `body` child list under a component that takes no children draws `not-a-container`, the code the `children` spelling draws. Both stay warnings.
  - The two sentences drop the renderer copy's `objectui#6771`, because `check:doc-authoring` refuses a tracker id in author-facing text (the module header keeps the citation). The renderer copy's text, `("body" was retired by objectui#6771)`, becomes `("body" is its retired spelling)`. `node-slot-walk-11170` pins the new text.
- **The tree.** `parseJsx` elements carry an enumerable, symbol-keyed marker. `JSON.stringify` and `Object.keys` do not see it. The consumers' suites pass unchanged (Verification).

### Tests (`packages/sdui-parser/src/__tests__`)

- **Ported whole (7):** `base-props-bind-hidden-11008`, `base-props-one-list-11044`, `body-dialect-6771`, `input-type-union`, `node-slot-walk-11170`, `provenance`, `tier`. Path pointers in comments are re-rooted to `ui/`. `provenance`'s "objectui-only" sentence now says what was true until this change.
- **ui-only cases merged into this package's twins (7):**
  - `containment-declared-slot` +3: the base key, the `body` spelling, and the `isContainer` projection. The import now comes from `../index.js`.
  - `dashboard-widget-options` +3: the retired-sub-caption shapes and their control.
  - `type-attribute-collision` +1: the no-`type` regression guard with provenance. Re-ablated: restoring `{ type: tag, ...props }` keeps all nine green, so the header now says "nine".
  - The plan's estimate was 12; the other five were already here under different titles or quote styles. `literal-subset`'s `__proto__` case is covered by this file's `it.each`, and `member-kind`'s two by `member-type-mismatch`.
- **Exact twins, so not ported (4):** `compile`, `html-tier-manifest-10735`, `inert-expression-6598`, `kanban-quick-add-8285`.
- **New:** `deprecated-type-aliases.test.ts` (2 cases) pins both aliases at type level. Negative control: re-pointing one fails `pnpm typecheck` with TS2344.
- **Left for PR 2 (5),** because each imports `@object-ui/*`, React or the spec, or reads ui sources: `injected-component-input-6950`, `inline-whitespace.test.tsx`, `render.test.tsx`, `spec-symbol-batch7`, `dashboard-widget-options-census`.
- **Severity.** No ported case pinned `warning` for a non-enum mismatch, so no expectation flipped.

### What this leaves for PR 2 and PR 3

- **PR 2** rewrites importers to `@objectstack/sdui-parser`. Old names are not for new code.
  - Once ui imports this package, a non-enum mismatch is an `error` in the Console too.
  - `ui/scripts/__tests__/unconsumed-widget-option-claim-6186.test.ts` reads the ui copy's `dashboard-widget-options.ts` path, and the census header here points at the census test's current path. Both move with it.
  - The old `body` message text is pinned in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/base-props-one-list-11044.test.tsx` and quoted in `ui/content/docs/components/layout/semantic.mdx`.
  - `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/sdui-parser.json` records `ui/packages/sdui-parser` as a registry source.
- **PR 3** retires `check:sdui-lockstep`. It is green on this head (9 and 9 sources agree), so the PRs can land in either order.

## Verification

Head `930df7bda`, on `main` `6b9355299`. 24 files, +1794 / −191, in two commits. Tier S: no governed path (each checked with `check-governed-merges --test`), under 3000 lines.

- **`@objectstack/sdui-parser`:** `vitest run`, 22 files, 349 tests pass. `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` (tsup + `check-dts-emitted`) exit 0.
- **Consumers, built against this dist:** `packages/lint` 164 files / 7356 tests pass; `packages/metadata-protocol` 266 files / 21539 tests pass (3 files / 19 tests skipped by their own guards).
- **`@objectstack/spec` `vitest --project repo`:**
  - On `1951e860e`: 1 of 1279 failed, `visibility-alias-keys-retirement`. It is the same failure CI's Test Core (1/8) showed on that head.
  - Its packages/** walk now reaches the ported `base-props-one-list-11044.test.ts`, whose fixture gives the SDUI tier's deprecated-but-accepted `visibleOn` base prop a value. Under `ui/` the walk never read it.
  - `930df7bda` adds the file to the walk's structural exclusions with its reason. That file then passes 12/12, and main's same shard is green.
- **`pnpm check:sdui-lockstep`:** OK in-tree. The grammar region is byte-identical (214 lines), all 25 codes agree, the containment predicate agrees, across 9 and 9 sources. PR 3 can land before or after this one.
- **Changeset gates:**
  - `check-changeset-no-major --event` with this body's declaration: level axis ✓, patch with `yes (narrowing)` and `none`.
  - `check-adr-0087-registration`: ✓, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

- **Gate sweep:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 120 gates on `930df7bda`. All 120 ran and exited 0. `--ran` reconciles 120 derived, 120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - Four spec gates that read built declarations (`check:api-surface`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`) first refused with exit 3 on a stale local spec `dist`. They were re-run green after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`.
  - Earlier passes:
    - Pass 1 (81 gates, pre-fix head) found `check-issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:published-files` red; see Behaviour and Licence.
    - Pass 2 (100 gates, `1951e860e`) was 100/100 green.
- **Push battery** (`GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`) on `930df7bda`: 2182 cases pass, 0 fail, EXIT 0. It was also 2182/0 on `1951e860e`.
- **CI on `930df7bda`:** 41 success, 8 skipped, 0 failed; mergeable `clean`.
